skills.name: reality-first-engineering
skills.description: Establish a fact-backed direction gate before consequential implementation.

skills.name: evidence-first-testing
skills.description: Preserve red-state evidence and prove that tests detect the intended behavior.

skills.name: design-integrity-review
skills.description: Review one change in a fresh context against its goal, non-goals, and acceptance condition for structural shortcuts; route acceptance-surface changes to behavioral review.

skills.name: behavioral-acceptance-review
skills.description: Independently audit tests, evals, generated artifacts, and user-visible workflows, including release verdicts for Agent products.

skills.name: review-md
skills.description: When explicitly invoked, draft or update a repository's REVIEW.md with its owner: frozen acceptance surfaces, sensitive paths, what failure looks like, and paths to skip.

skills.name: grilling
skills.description: When explicitly invoked, stress-test decisions in rounds, track the assumptions behind accepted recommendations, and stop at a human-confirmed handoff.

skills.name: project-map
skills.description: Keep a project's decisions, tickets, glossary, and living docs in a small local map; carry work from decisions to a spec, tracer-bullet build tickets, and one ticket per session; catch stale docs.

skills.name: architecture-flow-map
skills.description: Trace current modules, business objects, and 3–5 scenarios into map.json and an interactive HTML map; validate code references during the build and check the viewer in a browser.

skills.name: document-writing
skills.description: Draft, polish, or translate documents with natural target-language prose, semantic fidelity, and encoding protection; for academic papers, lead with the strongest supported contribution and remove defensive writing.

skills.name: asd-ste100
skills.description: When explicitly invoked, rewrite a given English or Simplified Chinese text into ASD-STE100-style controlled language so a model cannot misread it, keeping every fact and hedge.

skills.name: paper-annotation
skills.description: When explicitly invoked, turn an English paper into one two-column HTML page: original text with argument highlights and a Chinese translation, paragraph notes, and an argument overview, with every paragraph checked against the source.

skills.name: frontend-production
skills.description: Build and review web frontends to ship: product voice and visual direction, one visual family, motion, mobile web, and page-by-page engineering review.

skills.name: modern-web-guidance
skills.description: Third-party (GoogleChrome). Search and retrieve Baseline-aware guides for modern HTML, CSS, and client-side JS: which platform API to use, and the fallback where browser support is limited.
